step_results:
Perfect! I've successfully added weekly subscription support to subtrack. Here's what was implemented:

## Changes Made

### Core Functionality (`src/cycles.js`)
- Added `WEEK: 'weekly'` to the `CYCLE` object
- Implemented weekly billing calculation: monthly cost = `price × 52 ÷ 12`, rounded to nearest cent
- Added weekly charge calculation: charges every 7 days from the first charge date (`--since`)

### CLI Updates (`bin/subtrack.js`)
- Updated usage to show `--every month|week|year` 
- Added week/weekly to the `EVERY` options mapping
- Updated error message to mention week as a valid option
- Added weekly to `SHARE_PER_MONTH` for correct monthly cost calculations

### Export Support (`src/export.js`)
- Added weekly cycle to the `MONTHS` mapping for CSV export

### Bug Fix (`src/renewals.js`)
- Fixed sorting to use actual dates instead of short labels, preventing incorrect ordering across month boundaries

### Tests
- Added tests for weekly subscription calculations
- Added tests for weekly CLI commands (add, list, total)
- Added tests for weekly renewals showing correct 7-day intervals

## Usage Example

```sh
subtrack add "Meal kit" 59.90 --every week  # €59.90 weekly
subtrack list                               # Shows €259.56 monthly cost
subtrack renewals --within 14              # Shows charges every 7 days
```

All 38 tests pass, including the new weekly subscription tests. The implementation correctly handles:
- ✅ Adding weekly subscriptions with `--every week`
- ✅ Calculating monthly equivalent cost (price × 52 ÷ 12)
- ✅ Showing weekly charges in renewals list (every 7 days)
- ✅ CSV export with correct monthly costs
- ✅ Proper date calculations across month/year boundaries
